name: Vegetable Yakisoba
steps: Whisk vegetarian Worcestershire, ketchup, mushroom stir-fry sauce, soy sauce and sugar until smooth. Confirm the Worcestershire and mushroom sauce contain no animal-derived ingredients or oyster. Prepare the cabbage, carrot, pepper, mushrooms, sprouts and onions before heating the pan.
Pat tofu dry. Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear tofu strips for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. Remove to a plate.

Heat the remaining 20 ml oil in the same pan. Stir-fry mushrooms and the white parts of the onions for 2 minutes. Add carrot, pepper and cabbage and cook 3–4 minutes until just tender. Add sprouts and stir for 1 minute.

Loosen the steamed eggless noodles by hand and add them with the measured 45 ml water. Cover for 1 minute to steam, then lift and separate with tongs. Return the tofu and pour in the prepared sauce; stir-fry 2–3 minutes until noodles are hot and evenly glossy with some browned edges.
Divide among four plates. Scatter the green onion over the top and serve the drained red pickled ginger to the side. Eat promptly while noodles are springy and vegetables retain bite.
tips: Packaged yakisoba noodles and Worcestershire can contain egg or fish; choose labelled egg-free and vegetarian products. The reviewed photo shows noodles, tofu, cabbage, carrot, green pepper, shiitake, sprouts and red pickled ginger.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
